attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OPNsense) to route between lan-a (opt1/vtnet1, 10.50.1.0/24, node2) and lan-b (opt2/vtnet2, 10.50.2.0/24, node3). Created a single named port alias "node3_svc_ports" (8080, 8443, 9000) in /conf/config.xml and one firewall pass rule referencing that alias to permit node2 -> node3 TCP traffic on those ports; a non-listed port (9999) remains blocked by the default-deny ruleset. All three nodes were restarted one at a time (node1 via `shutdown -r now`, node2/node3 via `reboot`), boot identity change was proven on each (FreeBSD kern.boottime and Linux boot_id), and post-restart the interface config, alias-expanded pf rules, static IPs/routes, and end-to-end port reachability were all re-verified as healthy.
